# Barakat Qurtas

Independent Kurdish graphic designer in Hewler, Kurdistan Region of Iraq.

Primary pages:
- https://bqurtas.com/design — portfolio by discipline.
- https://bqurtas.com/panjamor — Panjamor Office Studio: brand, print and launch systems for business owners.
- https://bqurtas.com/work — selected brand identity case studies.
- https://bqurtas.com/brandboard — bilingual identity starter.
- https://bqurtas.com/blog — journal notes on typography, place and design practice.
- https://bqurtas.com/bio — biography, experience and skills.
- https://bqurtas.com/contact — project enquiries.

Panjamor Office Studio:
Panjamor is a focused studio room for name checks, logo direction, Kurdish and Latin lockups, colour palettes, type pairing, printed matter, social launch kits, production-ready exports and owner handover.

Languages:
The site is available in English, Sorani Kurdish, Kurmanci Kurdish, Arabic, French, Turkish and Swedish.

Contact:
https://bqurtas.com/contact
